description.html: The Nomoy Pet ND-13 is a mini ceramic heat lamp (Mini Ceramic Lamp) for terrariums. A ceramic heater radiates heat without visible light, so it can run day and night without disturbing the animal's daily rhythm. The mini size suits smaller terrariums and topping up heat when the main lamp does not cover the whole day.

This type of heater is often used for night-time heating in species whose temperature must not drop too far, and for snakes and geckos that do not need bright light. It provides no UVB, so day-active species also need suitable UVB lighting.

A ceramic heater gets very hot, so fit it only in a heat-resistant ceramic socket, never a plastic one. Place it where the animal cannot touch it, for example behind mesh or in a guard, and on one side of the terrarium so a cooler zone remains.

Always connect the heater to a thermostat and check the temperature with a thermometer. It stays hot for a while after switching off. Call us for the exact wattage and a recommendation for your terrarium, and see sockets and thermostats in our equipment range.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
